canonical_source.resolved_control: Save & Test submit button inside the credentials EditForm
canonical_source.behavior: The source submits the current WordPress credential form, saves the credential, tests connectivity, clears the application-password field, and reloads authoritative Site Details state.

laravel_adaptation.adaptation_reason: Laravel uses paired connector credentials rather than duplicating the desktop application's manually entered WordPress application-password store. Save & Test therefore tests the already-saved paired connector secret and persists verification state while retaining the stronger connector protocol boundary.
laravel_adaptation.secret_storage: Connector.encrypted_secret is encrypted at rest and Hidden from serialization.
laravel_adaptation.browser_secret_policy: The control sends no credential body and never reads, renders, or echoes encrypted_secret or an application password.
laravel_adaptation.authoritative_reconciliation: After the verify POST succeeds, the control rereads the exact advertised Site Details API; reconciliation failure is surfaced as an authoritative reconciliation error rather than fake success.

tenant_isolation.proof: The focused tests retain explicit foreign/cross-tenant 404 semantics, derive the verify URL only from the exact server-advertised tenant Site Details contract, reject caller-shaped or external URLs, and rely on the existing tenant-scoped Site and Connector models.
tenant_isolation.caller_override_probe: Only /api/tenants/{tenant}/sites/{positive-integer} is accepted as a derivation source; query strings, traversal-shaped paths and absolute foreign origins fail closed.

coverage: foreign tenant 404 and missing permission 403 focused contract
GET Site Details -> POST verify -> authoritative GET Site Details sequence
no application-password or encrypted-secret request body

terminality.basis: The canonical Site Details Save & Test control is now a real production Laravel control over the existing tenant-scoped paired connector credential. It preserves connector.manage authorization, tenant/site isolation, encrypted secret storage and authoritative post-action reread, with focused deterministic frontend and PHP security tests and no fabricated live WordPress evidence.
